     3	## Brand
     4	Global Aid Alliance is a humanitarian nonprofit organization dedicated to disaster relief, emergency assistance, and community resilience worldwide. Founded in 1947, the organization mobilizes volunteers, donors, and partners to deliver critical aid when and where it's needed most. Our tone is professional yet warm — conveying urgency without despair, and hope grounded in action.

    21	CTA Primary: "Donate Now"

    24	## Mission Statement
    25	**Our Mission:** Global Aid Alliance prevents and alleviates human suffering in the face of emergencies by mobilizing the power of volunteers and the generosity of donors.
    26	
    27	We are guided by the fundamental principles of humanity, impartiality, and neutrality. Every day, our teams work across borders and boundaries to ensure that help reaches those who need it most — regardless of race, religion, nationality, or political affiliation. From the first hours of a disaster to the years of recovery that follow, we stand with affected communities every step of the way.
    28

    30	- **12 million** people assisted annually
    31	- **50,000 volunteers** active across our network
    32	- **190 countries** where we've provided aid
    33	- **$850 million raised** in the last fiscal year
    34	
    35	These figures represent real lives changed — families sheltered after storms, blood delivered to hospitals, and communities rebuilt stronger than before.
    36

    38	- **Disaster Relief** — Rapid deployment of emergency shelter, food, water, and medical supplies to communities affected by natural disasters and conflict. Our response teams are on the ground within 24 hours.
    39	- **Blood Donation** — Operating one of the largest blood collection networks, we supply approximately 40% of the nation's blood and blood products to hospitals and medical facilities.
    40	- **Emergency Preparedness** — Training individuals, families, and organizations to prepare for and respond to emergencies through workshops, certification courses, and community drills.
    41	- **International Humanitarian Aid** — Partnering with a global network of humanitarian organizations to deliver relief and recovery programs in conflict zones and disaster-affected regions worldwide.
    42	- **Community Health** — Providing health and safety education, disease prevention programs, and support services to underserved communities, including mental health resources for disaster survivors.

Start development 90 npm run dev 91 ``` 92 93 ### Turborepo Monorepo 94 95 ```bash 96 # Create monorepo 97 npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo 98 cd my-monorepo 99 100 # Structure: 101 # apps/web/ - Next.js application 102 # apps/docs/ - Documentation site 103 # packages/ui/ - Shared components with RemixIcon 104 # packages/config/ - Shared configs 105 # turbo.json - Pipeline configuration 106 107 # Run all apps 108 npm run dev 109 110 # Build all packages 111 npm run build 112 ``` 113 114 ### RemixIcon Integration 115 116 ```tsx 117 // Webfont (HTML/CSS) 118 119 120 121 // React component 122 import { RiHomeLine, RiSearchFill } from "@remixicon/react" 123 124 125 ``` 126 127 ## Reference Navigation 128 129 **Next.js References:** 130 - [App Router Architecture](./references/nextjs-app-router.md) - Routing, layouts, pages, parallel routes 131 - [Server Components](./references/nextjs-server-components.md) - RSC patterns, client vs server, streaming 132 - [Data Fetching](./references/nextjs-data-fetching.md) - fetch API, caching, revalidation, loading states 133 - [Optimization](./references/nextjs-optimization.md) - Images, fonts, scripts, bundle analysis, PPR 134 135 **Turborepo References:** 136 - [Setup & Configuration](./references/turborepo-setup.md) - Installation, workspace config, package structure 137 - [Task Pipelines](./references/turborepo-pipelines.md) - Dependencies, parallel execution, task ordering 138 - [Caching Strategies](./references/turborepo-caching.md) - Local cache, remote cache, cache invalidation 139 140 **RemixIcon References:** 141 - [Integration Guide](./references/remix-icon-integration.md) - Installation, usage, customization, accessibility 142 143 ## Common Patterns & Workflows 144 145 ### Pattern 1: Full-Stack Monorepo 146 147 ``` 148 my-monorepo/ 149 ├── apps/ 150 │ ├── web/ # <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">

    :root {
      --primary-red: #C41E3A;
      --primary-red-dark: #A01830;
      --navy: #1B3A5C;
      --navy-dark: #142B45;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --gray-50: #F8F9FA;
      --gray-100: #F1F3F5;
      --gray-200: #E9ECEF;
      --gray-300: #DEE2E6;
      --gray-400: #CED4DA;
      --gray-500: #ADB5BD;
      --gray-600: #868E96;
      --gray-700: #495057;
      --gray-800: #343A40;
      --gray-900: #212529;
      --font-heading: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      --font-body: 'Merriweather', Georgia, serif;
      --font-ui: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
      --radius-sm: 4px;
      --radius-md: 8px;
      --radius-lg: 12px;
      --transition: 0.25s ease;
    }

    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      color: var(--gray-800);
      line-height: 1.7;
      background: var(--white);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      line-height: 1.2;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    button {
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      background: none;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
    }

    /* Utility */
    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--primary-red);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--primary-red-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--navy);
      border: 2px solid var(--navy);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .btn-navy {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .btn-navy:hover {
      background: var(--navy-dark);
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 600px;
    }

    /* Header */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: var(--white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .header-top {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      padding: 8px 0;
    }

    .header-top .container {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .header-top a {
      opacity: 0.85;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }

    .header-top a:hover {
      opacity: 1;
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .header-main {
      padding: 16px 0;
    }

    .header-main .container {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--gray-900);
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      background: var(--primary-red);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
    }

    .nav-desktop {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .nav-desktop a {
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-desktop a:hover {
      color: var(--primary-red);
    }

    .nav-desktop .btn {
      padding: 10px 22px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .menu-toggle {
      display: none;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    .menu-toggle:hover {

    // Mobile Navigation

      document.getElementById('mobileNav').classList.toggle('open');
      document.getElementById('mobileNavOverlay').classList.toggle('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = document.getElementById('mobileNav').classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
    }

    // Donate Modal
    function openDonateModal() {
      document.getElementById('donateModalOverlay').classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function closeDonateModal(event) {
      if (event && event.target !== document.getElementById('donateModalOverlay')) return;
      document.getElementById('donateModalOverlay').classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    let selectedAmount = null;

    function selectAmount(el, amount) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.amount-option').forEach(opt => opt.classList.remove('selected'));
      el.classList.add('selected');
      selectedAmount = amount;
      const customWrap = document.getElementById('customAmountWrap');
      if (amount === 'custom') {
        customWrap.style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('customAmount').focus();
      } else {
        customWrap.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }

    function submitDonation() {
      let amount = selectedAmount;
      if (amount === 'custom') {
        amount = document.getElementById('customAmount').value;
      }
      if (!amount || amount === 'custom') {
        alert('Please select or enter a donation amount.');
        return;
      }
      alert('Thank you for your generosity! Redirecting to secure checkout for $' + amount + '.');
      closeDonateModal();
    }

    // Accordion
    function toggleAccordion(header) {
      const item = header.parentElement;
      const wasOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
      document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('open'));
      if (!wasOpen) {
        item.classList.add('open');
      }
    }

    // News Carousel
    let newsIndex = 0;
    const newsTrack = document.getElementById('newsTrack');
    const newsCards = newsTrack.children;

    function getCardsPerView() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 767) return 1;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 991) return 2;
      return 3;
    }

    function moveNews(direction) {
      const cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
      const maxIndex = Math.max(0, newsCards.length - cardsPerView);
      newsIndex += direction;
      if (newsIndex < 0) newsIndex = maxIndex;
      if (newsIndex > maxIndex) newsIndex = 0;
      const cardWidth = newsCards[0].offsetWidth + 24; // gap
      newsTrack.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (newsIndex * cardWidth) + 'px)';
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      newsIndex = 0;
      newsTrack.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
    });

    // Animated Counters
    function animateCounters() {
      const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            const el = entry.target;
            const target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-target'), 10);
            const suffix = el.parentElement.querySelector('.stat-label').textContent;
            let prefix = '';
            let displaySuffix = '';
            if (suffix.includes('million')) displaySuffix = 'M';
            else if (suffix.includes('thousand')) displaySuffix = 'K';
            else if (suffix.includes('countries')) displaySuffix = '';
            else if (suffix.includes('million')) displaySuffix = 'M';
            if (suffix.includes('dollars')) prefix = '$';

            let current = 0;
            const duration = 1800;
            const stepTime = 20;
            const steps = duration / stepTime;
            const increment = target / steps;

            const timer = setInterval(() => {
              current += increment;
              if (current >= target) {
                current = target;
                clearInterval(timer);
              }
              el.textContent = prefix + Math.floor(current) + displaySuffix;
            }, stepTime);

            observer.unobserve(el);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.4 });

      counters.forEach(c => observer.observe(c));
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', animateCounters);

    // Close modal on Escape key
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeDonateModal();
        const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
        if (mobileNav.classList.contains('open')) toggleMobileNav();
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

The Global Aid Alliance single-page website is complete and verified. Here's a summary of what was built:

### Output
- **File**: `/app/output/index.html`
- **Type**: Single-page, self-contained HTML (no build step required)
- **Verified**: Serves correctly on `http://localhost:8080/index.html`

### Sections Implemented
1. **Header** — Sticky navigation with utility bar (Sign In, Contact Us, Español), logo, desktop nav, and mobile hamburger menu
2. **Hero** — Full-width navy gradient with headline, subtitle, and two CTAs ("Donate Now" + "Become a Volunteer")
3. **Mission** — Centered mission statement with supporting paragraph
4. **Impact Stats** — 4 animated counter cards (12M people, 50K volunteers, 190 countries, $850M raised) that animate on scroll
5. **Programs & Services** — 5-item accordion with smooth expand/collapse (Disaster Relief, Blood Donation, Emergency Preparedness, International Humanitarian Aid, Community Health)
6. **Get Involved** — 3-card grid for Volunteer, Fundraiser, and Blood Drive
7. **Latest News** — Functional carousel with next/previous arrow navigation (4 stories)
8. **Donate CTA** — Split layout with impact table showing donation amounts and their real-world effects
9. **Footer** — 5-column layout with Programs, Get Involved, About, Support, and social links

### Interactions
- **Mobile hamburger menu** — Slides in from the right with overlay
- **Donate modal** — Opens from hero CTA and header button; includes amount selection grid, custom amount input, and secure checkout simulation
- **News carousel** — Next/previous buttons advance cards responsively (3/2/1 per view)
- **Program accordion** — Click to expand/collapse with smooth animation
- **Animated counters** — Stats animate when scrolled into view
- **Keyboard support** — Escape key closes modal and mobile menu

### Design
- **Palette**: Deep red `#C41E3A`, navy `#1B3A5C`, warm grays, clean white
- **Typography**: Inter for headings/UI, Merriweather for body text
- **Icons**: RemixIcon via CDN
- **Responsive**: Fully adaptive from desktop to mobile with optimized breakpoints
